title: 第8章 干净利落
content_zh:
第8章干净利落
晌午时分，江岸风雨潇潇。
几艘空船停靠在港口内，码头集市鲜有人迹，勾栏酒肆中时而传来吆喝：
“来喝……”
“大大大……唉——”
集市建筑大多老旧，但紧邻的江岸，却有一座依山傍水的别院，隐于林木之间，自码头只能瞧见飞檐青瓦。
庄园名为青莲山庄，是京城权贵的私宅，盛夏酷暑才会来住几天，平时都交给‘护院’打理，顺便看着码头的生意；‘青莲帮’的名字也是由此而来。
虽然名叫‘青莲帮’，但其和江湖帮派毫无关系，里面算江湖人的就帮主杨冠，其他人都是纠集的地痞闲汉，约莫百余人上下。
杨冠自幼在邬州三绝谷学艺，本事不差，在京城扎根后，靠着人脉短短几月时间，就摆平了码头上的地头蛇，独占了江安码头，最近还把手伸到了京城内部，想扩展业务。
能在京城做生意的家族，大多背靠豪门，非富即贵；没背景的街巷，也早已有了地头蛇盘踞。
杨冠物色许久，就发现天水桥这片非常干净！
裴家为首的几个商贾，手上有钱家里没人做官，附近还没有其他地头蛇抢地盘。
这么大只肥羊摆在哪里，和白给的地盘一样，杨冠自然不会客气，这个月都在和商户‘沟通’，尝试在天水桥站稳脚跟。
杨冠的志向无疑是远大的，但后果也立竿见影。
晌午时分，青莲山庄内，身着员外袍的杨冠，在客厅之中，侃侃而谈：
“天水桥的裴三娘，是真不给面子，杨某下了两次请帖，都不曾赏脸，坐下来喝茶聊两句罢了，又不是贪恋她姿色……”
“唉，裴三娘脾气硬，和官府也有点交情，附近的商家，都是看她的意思。杨员外想派些人手，帮忙驱逐闹事儿的闲汉，是好事。但裴大东家不答应，我们这几家，实在不好拍板……”
几个大东家，都是天水桥附近的豪商，对于杨冠这种地头蛇，商贾之家也不敢得罪，只是委婉拉扯，把事情往没到场的裴家身上推；要是裴家都顶不住，那这‘辛苦钱’确实得给。
杨冠也不清楚裴家女人当家，为何口气这么硬。还想恩威并施，让几个东家代为传话，外面忽然传来呼喊：
“帮主，帮主……”

客厅里的几位员外，收声看向门外。
身着员外袍的杨冠，把茶杯拍在案上：
“说了多少次，叫东家。”
客厅外跑进来的佩刀汉子，气喘吁吁进门：
“东家，有客人到访，天水桥的陈镖头驾车，说是裴家的大少爷……”
“嗯？”
几个员外郎，听见这话一愣。
裴家的大少爷裴洛，名气可不小。因为是裴家独苗，裴家自幼对其颇为纵容，花天酒地不务正业，算是附近有名的败家子。
杨冠显然也听说过裴大少爷的名声，眼神意外：
“裴三娘不亲自来，让这么个纨绔上门，是搪塞杨某不成？让人进来。”
几个员外郎，见此顺势起身：
“那我等先告辞，杨员外和裴公子慢慢聊，聊好了差人知会我等一声即可。”
杨冠端茶送客，坐在中堂下等待。
踏踏踏——
很快，密集脚步声，从院外走道响起。
随着小厮抬手引路，一名黑袍公子大步走了进来，身侧颇高，面色冷峻，气势不俗。
在天水桥有点名气的陈大镖头，小跑在跟前撑伞，态度颇为谄媚。
而后面还跟着五个镖师，为首老叟提着把黑鞘长刀。
杨冠挑了挑眉毛，觉得来人不是游手好闲的纨绔，放下了茶杯。
刚刚走出门的几个豪商，对昨天镇远镖局的事儿有所耳闻，估摸这陌生公子，就是昨天来的那个狠人，当下也都停住了脚步，拱手招呼：

“公子倒是面生。您是裴家的大少爷？”
夜惊堂没有回应，大步走上台阶，从杨朝手里接过佩刀，直接进入大门。
卡塔——
大门被关上，把一脸茫然的众人都给关在了外面。
陈彪差点一鼻子嘭在门上，正想询问少东家作甚，就听见屋里传来：
呛啷——
拔刀声！
屋里，坐在主位的杨冠，发现势头不对，抬手就伸向了摆在中堂下的阔背大刀。
也是在同一时刻，夜惊堂身形猛然前冲，半空长刀出鞘，一记力劈华山，直接劈向杨冠头顶。
客厅中刀光一闪。
杨冠身手不差，大刀眨眼已经横举身前，但彼此爆发力差距太大，刚刚抬手，就被一记重刀，砸的刀背撞在胸口，直接压碎了坐下的太师椅。
哗啦——
“你——”
杨冠摔在地上，想要怒斥，却发现面前这忽然上门的小子，直接冲着杀人来的，转眼又是一刀，捅向心门。
杨冠毛骨悚然，自幼所学之艺业在此刻发挥到极致，双脚猛蹬地板，硬生生拉开了与刀锋的距离，同时提刀还手。
刀锋再次相撞。
杨冠一刀劈出去，未曾伤及对手分毫，反倒被对方的巨力劈了回来，后背抵住的漆木中堂，当即撞烂，整个人摔出了后方的穿堂门。
“咳——”
杨冠摔入后方庭院的雨幕中，发出一声闷咳，都没来得及看前方，就全力往侧面翻滚。
而不出他所料，下一刻，一把刀就砍在了他落地的位置，入石三分有余。

“你这厮……”
杨冠连滚带爬起身，脸色暴怒提着刀想说话，却见那面无表情的年轻人，拔出长刀再度走来，不紧不慢，还扭了下脖子，眼中并不凶狠，只透着习以为常的平淡。
杨冠心中惊悚，其他没看出来，只看出来这小子肯定杀过人。
他双手握刀怒喝一声，看似想要冲上，但脚步却往宅院后方挪动，拉开几步，就提刀往后院跑，同时大喊：
“来人，都他娘死了……”
话刚出口，背后就传来刺骨寒风。
杨冠身手着实不差，反手一刀，准确无误挡住了劈来的刀锋，但身体扛不住巨力，直接被劈得往前扑倒在地，手中刀也被震脱了手。
叮咣——
杨冠来不及管大刀，爬起来就想往后屋跑，但这次再也没了机会，刚刚爬起，后脑勺就是一沉，被靴子直接踩的贴住湿漉漉的青石地砖，一道寒芒从眼前落下。
“少侠且慢！饶命饶命……”
雨幕潇潇的雅致庭院里，传出一声撕心裂肺的呼喊。
夜惊堂静立雨中，踩着杨冠的左脸，刀锋插在他眼前，低头看着，此时才有了点表情：
“你给裴家下帖子，叫人来谈事儿？谈什么，说吧。”
杨冠面色扭曲，却没有半分愤怒，只是死死盯着眼前的刀：
“误会，误会。我猪油蒙了心，不晓得少侠也是裴家人。这里是京城，出人命不好交待，少侠别冲动……”
“听说你是‘三绝仙翁’的徒弟，这身手不太像。”
杨冠没想到这小子还知道他师父是谁，但现在也不敢狂，连忙解释：
“记名徒弟，家里和师父有点交情，登门学了几年艺，没得真传，让英雄见笑……”
“看在你师父名望上，留你一条命。”
“多谢少侠大恩……啊——”

杨冠话未说完，就是一声惨叫。
只见刀锋拔出又落下，直接插入右臂，钉如青石。
杨冠面容直接扭曲，看向夜惊堂，眼神惊恐，根本说不出话来。
“这一刀，是怕你觉得我不敢下手。我可能弄不死你师父，弄死你真不费力。告辞。”
夜惊堂拔出佩刀，带血刀锋在杨冠衣服上擦了擦，收刀入鞘，转身走向客厅。
杨冠紧咬牙关，捂住血流如注的右臂爬起来，硬是没敢出声痛呼，目送夜惊堂离开。
吱呀——
客厅大门
外面的院子里，已经围了几十号手持铁器的泼皮；杨朝和陈彪等镖师，则握刀如临大敌守在门前。
而几个面色惊疑的豪商，则站在院门处。
夜惊堂把门带上，刀丢给杨朝，接过雨伞撑在头顶：
“谈完了，走吧。”
“这么麻利……”
陈彪小声嘟囔了一句，却没问怎么办的，毕竟屋里面的响动和惨嚎，外面人都听在耳中，傻子都知道怎么谈的事情。
院子里的一帮打手，见‘帮主’都没露面，哪里敢拦，纷纷在雨中让开了道路。
几个豪商不清楚这裴家后生，是不是直接把杨冠砍死了，也不敢搭话。
沙沙沙……
偌大庄园内鸦雀无声，只有一把黑伞，不紧不慢飘出了白墙青瓦间的巷道。
直到马车从大门外离开，院子里才重新出现响动：
“帮主？帮主你没事吧？这大但狂徒，竟敢……快去报官……”

“滚！一帮子废物……还报官……”

Chapter 8 Clean and neat
At noon, the river bank is filled with wind and rain.
Several empty ships were docked in the port, and there were few people in the dock market. From time to time, shouts came from the Goulan Wine Shop:
"Come and drink..."
"Big, big... Oh -"
Most of the market buildings are old, but on the adjacent river bank, there is a courtyard nestled between mountains and rivers, hidden among the trees. From the pier, only blue eaves and green tiles can be seen.
The manor is called Qinglian Villa, and it is the private residence of the powerful people in the capital. They only come to stay for a few days in the hot summer, and they are usually taken care of by the 'nursing house', and they also watch the business of the dock; this is where the name of the 'Qinglian Gang' comes from.
Although it is called the 'Qinglian Gang', it has nothing to do with the Jianghu Gang. The only one who counts as a Jianghu Gang is the gang leader Yang Guan, and the others are all local gangsters, about a hundred people.
Yang Guan studied art in Wuzhou Sanjue Valley since he was a child, and his skills are not bad. After taking root in the capital, he relied on his connections to get rid of the local snakes on the dock in just a few months, and monopolized Jiang'an Wharf. Recently, he also reached out to the inside of the capital, hoping to expand his business.
Most of the families that can do business in the capital are backed by wealthy families and are either rich or noble; local snakes have long been entrenched in the streets and alleys without backgrounds.
Yang Guan searched for a long time and found that the Tianshui Bridge area was very clean!
Several merchants headed by the Pei family have money, no one is an official, and there are no other local snakes nearby to grab the territory.
Wherever such a big fat sheep is placed, it is the same as the land given for free. Yang Guan will naturally not be polite. He has been 'communicating' with merchants this month and trying to gain a foothold in Tianshuiqiao.
Yang Guan's ambitions are undoubtedly lofty, but the consequences are immediate.
At noon, in Qinglian Villa, Yang Guan, wearing a member's outer robe, was talking eloquently in the living room:
"Pei Sanniang from Tianshuiqiao is really disrespectful. Yang sent out two invitations, but she didn't show any respect. She just sat down to drink tea and chat for a while. It's not like she was greedy for her beauty..."
"Well, Pei Sanniang has a strong temper and has some friendship with the government. The nearby businesses all follow her wishes. It's a good thing that Yang Yuanwai wants to send some people to help drive away the troublemakers. But Pei Dadong's family doesn't agree. It's really hard for us to make a decision..."
The big bosses were all wealthy businessmen near Tianshui Bridge. For local gangsters like Yang Guan, the merchant family did not dare to offend. They just tried to tactfully push the matter onto the Pei family who was not present. If the Pei family could not withstand it, then the 'hard-earned money' would indeed be given.
Yang Guan didn't know why the woman in charge of the Pei family had such a harsh tone. Still wanting to show kindness and power at the same time, he asked several bosses to pass the message on his behalf, but suddenly there was a shout from outside:
"Gang leader, gang leader..."
Several people in the living room muted their voices and looked outside the door.
Yang Guan, wearing a member's outer robe, patted the tea cup on the table:
"How many times have I told you to call me boss?"
The man with the sword ran in from outside the living room and came in panting:
"My boss, there is a visitor here. The head escort from Tianshuiqiao, Chen, is driving. He says he is the eldest young master of the Pei family..."
"Huh?"
Several foreign ministers were stunned when they heard this.
Pei Luo, the eldest young master of the Pei family, is quite famous. Because he is the only child of the Pei family, the Pei family has indulged him since he was a child. He spends a lot of time and alcohol instead of doing his job, and he is considered a famous prodigal in the neighborhood.
Yang Guan had obviously heard of Master Pei's reputation, and his eyes were surprised:
"Pei Sanniang didn't come in person. If you let such a dandy come to your door, are you trying to prevaricate Yang? Let him come in."
Several foreign ministers saw this and stood up:
"Then I'll take my leave first. Officer Yang and Mr. Pei will chat slowly. Once they're done, send someone to let me know."
Yang Guan served tea to the guests and sat under the central hall to wait.
Tap tap tap——
Soon, the sound of dense footsteps sounded from the corridor outside the courtyard.
As the waiter raised his hand to lead the way, a young man in black robe strode in. He was tall, with a stern face and impressive aura.
Chen Datou, who was somewhat famous in Tianshuiqiao, trotted in front of him holding an umbrella, and his attitude was quite flattering.
And behind them were five escorts, headed byThe old man was carrying a long black sheath knife.
Yang Guan raised his eyebrows, feeling that the person coming was not an idle playboy, so he put down the tea cup.
Several wealthy businessmen who had just walked out had heard about what happened at the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau yesterday. They estimated that this strange young man was the ruthless man who came yesterday. They all stopped in their tracks and greeted him:
"The young master is quite unfamiliar. Are you the eldest young master of the Pei family?"
Ye Jingtang did not respond, strode up the steps, took the saber from Yang Chao's hand, and entered the gate directly.
Kata——
The door was closed, shutting out everyone who looked confused.
Chen Biao almost banged his nose on the door. Just as he was about to ask what Shaodong was doing, he heard from inside the house:
Choking——
The sound of drawing a sword!
In the room, Yang Guan, who was sitting in the main seat, realized that the momentum was not right, so he raised his hand and reached for the broad-backed sword placed under the nave.
At the same moment, Ye Jingtang suddenly rushed forward, unsheathed his long sword in mid-air, and slashed Huashan directly towards Yang Guan's head.
There was a flash of sword light in the living room.
Yang Guan's skill was not bad, and the sword was already raised in front of him in the blink of an eye, but the difference in explosive power between them was too big. As soon as he raised his hand, he was hit by a heavy sword, and the back of the sword hit his chest, directly crushing the chair where he was sitting.
Wow——
"You——"
Yang Guan fell to the ground and wanted to reprimand, but found that the boy in front of him who suddenly came to the door was directly aiming to kill people. In the blink of an eye, he stabbed the door of his heart with another knife.
Yang Guan's hair stood on end. The skills he had learned since childhood were at their best at this moment. He kicked the floor with both feet, forcibly widening the distance between him and the blade, and at the same time raised the knife to fight back.
The blades collided again.
Yang Guan slashed out with his sword, without injuring his opponent at all. Instead, he was knocked back by the opponent's huge force. The lacquered wooden nave where his back was pressed was smashed immediately, and he fell out of the passage door at the rear.
"Ahem——"
Yang Guan fell into the rain curtain in the rear courtyard and let out a muffled cough. He didn't even have time to look ahead and rolled sideways with all his strength.
As he expected, the next moment, a knife struck the spot where he landed, more than three points into the stone.
"You guys..."
Yang Guan rolled up and stood up, with an angry face and holding the knife and wanted to speak, but he saw the expressionless young man pulled out the long knife and walked over again, unhurriedly, and even twisted his neck. His eyes were not fierce, but showed the usual calmness.
Yang Guan was horrified. He didn't see anything else, except that this kid must have killed someone before.
He held the knife in both hands and shouted angrily. He seemed to want to charge forward, but instead moved towards the back of the house. He pulled away a few steps, then ran toward the backyard with the knife in hand, shouting at the same time:
"Whoever comes here is fucking dead..."
As soon as the words came out, a biting cold wind came from behind.
Yang Guan's skills were really good. He made a backhand slash and accurately blocked the incoming blade. However, his body could not withstand the huge force and he was knocked forward and fell to the ground. The knife in his hand was also knocked out of his hand.
Ding-ding——
Yang Guan didn't have time to worry about the big knife, so he got up and wanted to run to the back room, but there was no chance this time. As soon as he got up, the back of his head sank, and he was stepped on by his boots directly against the wet bluestone floor tiles, and a cold light fell from before his eyes.
"Wait a minute, young hero! Spare your life, spare your life..."
A heartbreaking cry came from the elegant courtyard under the drizzle of rain.
Ye Jingtang stood quietly in the rain, stepping on the left side of Yang Guan's face, inserting the blade in front of his eyes, looking down, and then he had some expression:
"You send a message to the Pei family and ask someone to come and talk about it? Let's talk about what."
Yang Guan's face was distorted, but he was not angry at all. He just stared at the knife in front of him:
"Misunderstanding, misunderstanding. I was blinded by lard, and I didn't know that Young Hero was also a member of the Pei family. This is the capital, and it's hard to explain people's lives. Young Hero, don't be impulsive..."
"I heard that you are the apprentice of the 'Three Ultimate Immortals', but your skills are not very similar."
Yang Guan didn't expect that this kid knew who his master was, but he didn't dare to be crazy now and quickly explained:
"Registered apprentice, my family has some friendship with the master, and I came to learn a few lessons.Nian’s art cannot be truly passed down, so it makes heroes laugh..."
"For the sake of your master's reputation, I will spare your life. "
"Thank you so much, young hero...ah——"
Before Yang Guan finished speaking, he screamed.
The blade was pulled out and then dropped, directly inserted into the right arm, like a nail like bluestone.
Yang Guan's face was directly distorted, and he looked at Ye Jingtang, his eyes were horrified, and he was speechless at all.
"This knife is just because I'm afraid you think I don't dare to strike. I may not be able to kill your master, but it’s really easy to kill you. Farewell. "
Ye Jingtang pulled out his sword, wiped the bloody blade on Yang Guan's clothes, sheathed the sword, turned and walked towards the living room.
Yang Guan gritted his teeth, covered his bleeding right arm and got up, not daring to cry out in pain, and watched Ye Jingtang leave.
Squeak——
living room door
In the courtyard outside, dozens of gangsters armed with iron weapons had surrounded them; bodyguards such as Yang Chao and Chen Biao stood guard in front of the door with swords in hand as if they were faced with a formidable enemy.
Several wealthy businessmen with surprised expressions stood at the gate of the courtyard.
Ye Jingtang closed the door, threw the knife to Yang Chao, took the umbrella and held it above his head:
"Done talking, let's go. "
"So easy..."
Chen Biao muttered something in a low voice, but did not ask what to do. After all, the noises and howls in the house could be heard by people outside, and even fools knew how to talk about it.
A group of thugs in the yard, seeing that the 'gang leader' didn't even show up, dared to stop him, so they all moved out of the way in the rain.
Several wealthy businessmen didn't know whether the descendant of the Pei family had directly hacked Yang Guan to death, and they didn't dare to talk to him.
swish swish...
There was silence in the huge manor, except for a black umbrella, which slowly floated out of the alleyway between the white walls and blue tiles.
It wasn't until the carriage left the gate that the noise reappeared in the yard:
"Gang leader? Gang leader, are you okay? How dare this madman... report it to the official..."
"Get out! They are a bunch of trash... and they still report to the official..."
